about.title: About
paragraphs: I build digital products end to end: from the business idea to architecture, backend and APIs, mobile and web apps, admin panels, and deployment. In 7+ years I've worked on 12 production apps across e-commerce, travel, fintech, and government — building some from scratch, and taking over, extending and releasing others. They include a weather forecasting platform for Iraq's national meteorological authority.

My core stack is Flutter for cross-platform mobile, and Laravel/PHP with MySQL for backends, with React on the web and C#/.NET for business systems. I work directly with clients from requirements to store release, which means fewer handoffs and faster delivery.

I'm available to join a team in Saudi Arabia or the GCC full-time, to build your product under contract, or to partner with a startup as its founding or lead engineer — contributing to the digital transformation driving Vision 2030. Fluent in Arabic and English.
